page: Vultr vbm-64c-2048gb-8-l40-gpu is a dedicated bare metal server configured for high-density computational workloads. It features two Intel Xeon 6448H processors providing a total of 64 physical cores and 128 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture. Operating at a base frequency of 2.4 GHz, these dedicated cores deliver consistent processing power without virtualization overhead.

The system is equipped with 2048.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 16.0 GB per physical core. For acceleration, the server integrates eight NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined 384 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. Local storage is provided by a 960 GB solid-state drive, and the configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given its bare metal architecture and massive GPU-to-CPU resource density, this server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise-scale deployments that require raw hardware access without hypervisor tax. The combination of 128 vCPUs, 2 TB of RAM, and eight L40S GPUs makes this server highly suitable for large-scale machine learning training, LLM inference, high-performance computing, and complex data science pipelines.
